meta.description: Minimal database handle for Go — Dbh couples a *sql.DB with its dialect tag, and SqlExecutor is the virtual contract satisfied by *sql.DB, *sql.Tx and *Dbh alike, so one signature runs the same queries inside and outside transactions. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/dbh or when Go code needs one contract over connections and transactions. Driver subpackages are planned.
